title: Print Numbers 1 to N
problem: Given a positive integer N on a single line of input, print the integers from 1 to N, each on its own line.
starter_code:
# Read a positive integer N.
# Print 1, 2, 3, ... up to and including N, one per line.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Think about using a loop that counts from 1 up to N.
hints.2: A for loop with range(1, N+1) will give you each number from 1 to N in order.
hints.3: for i in range(1, int(input()) + 1): print(i)

failure_explanation: Make sure your loop includes N itself - range(1, N+1), not range(1, N) - and that you print each number on its own line rather than all on one line.
